tools.name: render_og_image
tools.description: Build a hosted Open Graph PNG and return a stable https://ogstamp.com/i/{id}.png URL for og:image. Requires api_key (ogs_… from https://ogstamp.com/pricing/). One credit per image. Does not return a free hotlink.

tools.name: og_image_from_url
tools.description: Build a hosted Open Graph card from a public page (title, description, favicon, theme-color) and return https://ogstamp.com/i/{id}.png. Requires api_key. One credit. Does not return a free hotlink.

tools.name: og_pricing
tools.description: Return OG Stamp credit packs. Credits never expire. PayPal one-time, not a subscription.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "render_og_image" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Build a 1200x630 Open Graph PNG. Supports title, subtitle, badge, theme, logo_url (https), and hex colors bg/fg/accent. Free light use is watermarked and capped per site (10/day). Production: POST https://ogstamp.com/api/og with Bearer ogs_…. Add store=1&format=json to get a stable hosted https://og" → after: "Build a hosted Open Graph PNG and return a stable https://ogstamp.com/i/{id}.png URL for og:image. Requires api_key (ogs_… from https://ogstamp.com/pricing/). One credit per image. Does not return a free hotlink."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
